notes.title: Progress update 2024-07-19
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44793087/b6c098de8a91a6f392aa843c02c8d29fc5c4e4db.jpg[/img]

An update on the development of Sable's Grimoire 2 has just been posted on the Zetsubou Games website.

https://zetsubou.games/blog-2024-07-19/

It details where the different aspects of the game (artwork, writing, etc.) are up to, and what is expected to be completed over the next few months.

There is no updated ETA at this point in time, though I plan on posting another progress update in a few months time, at which point a rough ETA should be possible to provide.
